body: spawnAuthenticatedAdlc, execAuthenticatedAdlc and execFileAuthenticatedAdlc in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs each call revalidateAdlcBinary with lockExecutable: true so the child runs from a pinned, read-only copy of the authenticated ADLC CLI. Hollow-test found that flipping any of those to false survives the suite. Add tests in test/adlc-bridge.test.mjs that run each wrapper against a copied @adlc/cli in a temp repo with a NODE_OPTIONS --require probe recording process.argv[1] of the child, and assert the child executed the pinned copy (not the original path under the temp repo). No production code change.
title: Pin the lockExecutable:true seal in the three authenticated-spawn wrappers with tests
